bron.prompt: Cinematic corporate photography for a private security company annual report. Shot on 35mm film, subtle grain, slightly desaturated colors with warm golden highlights and deep near-black shadows, occasional muted crimson accent. Low, warm side light or single-source interior light, strong contrast, calm and serious mood. Generous negative space for text overlay. No text, no logos, no watermarks, no flags. Two weathered 1970s Land Rovers parked on a red dirt road in African savanna at golden hour, a large baobab tree on the horizon, dust hanging in the warm light. Four men in plain olive field clothing stand beside the vehicles seen from behind, looking toward the horizon. The scene is calm and patient, as if they have been waiting a long time. The vehicles are early short-wheelbase utility vehicles with a canvas top, faded sand paint, completely unbadged: no badges, no lettering, no number plates. Composition: the vehicles and the four men grouped in the left third of the frame, the baobab small on the horizon to the right, a wide open sky and empty savanna on the right half. The men are silhouettes against the low sun, faces never visible. Aspect ratio 16:9.
